_doc: App pooled estimate vs source-verified published meta-analysis (k + estimate + inclusion-criteria assessment). Extends the 19 strict BENCHMARKS. Each entry MUST cite a real meta (PMID/DOI) and assess outcome/population match.

verified.note: App pools 0.78 (I2=67%) -- lower than published MACE because it mixes HF/renal-primary trials (DAPA-HF, EMPEROR, DAPA-CKD, EMPA-KIDNEY) into a MACE-labelled pool.

sources: Lee 2023 PLoS One HR 0.53 (0.41-0.68), 7 RCTs DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0294647
verified.note: App k=10 mixes 1L trials (SOLO1, PRIMA, PAOLA) with recurrent-disease trials (NOVA, ARIEL3, OReO) under a 1L label; 0.45 plausible for BRCAmut 1L but the trial set is heterogeneous vs the published 1L meta.
